requirements.text: The system must allow customers to book appointments online at any time, selecting their preferred service, barber, and time.
Customers should be able to cancel or change their appointments online without needing to call the shop.
The system must send appointment reminders to customers to reduce no-shows.
There should be a feature that allows customers to leave notes or preferences during the booking process to maintain a personal touch.
The implementation of the new system must not complicate the existing workflow of the barbershop or detract from the personal interactions that the barbershop is known for.
